title: Home Assistant Material: search from the top bar

Main.dc.html.title: Search button in the top bar: one tap from anywhere on a long page

n-search.text: The page search sits at the top of the content, so on a long page it scrolls away. The top bar never scrolls. A search button there opens the same search in the bar itself: no jump back to the top, the page stays where it was, and results filter or jump in place.
